title: R2-D2
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: Though he began in the service of Naboo royalty, R2-D2 served two generations of Skywalkers until he came into Luke's possession. From there, he accompanied his master on adventures across the galaxy to destroy the Empire. Sometimes, that forced the blue Astromech Droid to play parts, like the time he was given to Jabba the Hutt as a gift and forced to become a serving Droid on Jabba's barge.
